# Python packages for build_images.py and the photo-metadata check in
# audit_blog.py (deploy.yml, blog-audit.yml). Exact pins with the sha256 of
# the CPython 3.12 manylinux x86_64 wheel the runner installs, so pip runs in
# hash-checking mode and refuses anything else (`--only-binary :all:` keeps
# setup.py out entirely). Dependabot bumps pins and hashes together (see
# .github/dependabot.yml). Pillow >= 11.2 is the floor: AVIF.
Pillow==12.3.0 \
    --hash=sha256:78cb2c6865a35ab8ff8b75fd122f6033b92a62c82801110e48ddd6c936a45d91
